title: Abayoola Amayinja mu Kiwonvu eky’Edda
intro: Teebereza embuga y’empuku eyasituka mu biwonvu eby’amayinja mu Buwalabu, ng’ekuguse mu kuyoola amaka amalungi ennyo okuva ku nsozi. Baakulaakulana n’amaanyi n’obuyiiya, naye ate emboozi yaabwe erimu okujeemera okulabula okw’obwakatonda okunyogoga. Bw’onoogenda mu maaso n’okunoonyereza ku nfumo zaabwe, ojja kuzuula abantu amalala gaabwe ge gabaviirako okuzikirizibwa ddala. Baali baani?
clues: Twasikira ensi ey’ebiwonvu eby’amayinja n’enjazi empanvu, gye twazimba amayumba gaffe n’obukugu obutagigeraageranya.
Twali tumanyiddwa olw’okuyoola amaka amakuumi mu nsozi, nga tuwulira nga tetulina bulabe bwonna.
Omubaka yajja gye tuli okuva mu ffe, ng’atujjukiza ekisa kya Allah era ng’atulabula ku kibonerezo.
Twasaba akabonero, era engamiya enkazi ey’ekyamagero n’eva mu lwazi, ekigezo ekitegeerekeka okuva eri Allah.
Twajeemera okulabula ne tusala eŋŋamira enkazi, nga tusekerera omubaka era nga tuwakanya ekibonerezo.
Okubwatuka okumu kwatutuukako mu maka gaffe, era we bwakeeredde ne tugalamira nga tuvunnama, nga tulinga abatabeerangayo.
verse: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]. (69:5)
